title: FIPS gate missing: framework/key_export_private dispatch
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1509 — ioctl_key_export_private() dispatches ops->key_export_private() at line 1509 without calling ops->fips_gate() first. crypto2dev_provider.h explicitly lists key_export_private as a gated callback. No current provider implements key_export_private (all NULL), so this is not currently exploitable, but any provider that adds key_export_private will be called without the gate. The fix is to add the ops->fips_gate() call in ioctl_key_export_private before the dispatch, consistent with all other ioctl handlers.
